candidate_theorem.statement: If n3=4158 for a hypothetical srg(99,14,1,2), then rank_F7(M)>=22.

r7=19.contradiction: All outside columns would lie in col(B), but none of the 144 required z-neighbor columns does.

r7=20.contradiction: The twelve distinct Z patterns would lie on one quotient line, but every line contains at most four patterns.

r7=21.all_2+2+2_branch: Otherwise every edge is 2+2+2. The twelve Z patterns must form a perfect matching inside a quotient subspace of dimension at most two. All 1,923 two-spaces have matching number at most eight.
r7=21.type_2+4_branch: If a 2+4 edge exists, rank(B)=rank(K)=21, yet none of its 144 required z-neighbor columns lies in col(B).

limitations: Discovery cannot verify itself; independent verification is required.

rank_22_positive_control.meaning: A quotient of dimension three can contain all twelve forced Z patterns, so this local argument does not exclude r7=22.

outside_geometry.distinctness: The perfect-matching property already makes the twelve patterns distinct; alternatively, equal patterns would give two vertices at least three common neighbors, contradicting lambda=1 or mu=2.
outside_geometry.forced_perfect_matching: For each u in X, the nonedge uz has common neighbor x and one further common neighbor in Z; similarly for Y. Hence the twelve Z patterns form a perfect matching X--Y.
outside_vertex_equations: w is nonadjacent to x and y
outside_geometry.restricted_column: K[L,w]=1-2*A[L,w], i.e. 1 on nonedges and 6 on edges
outside_geometry.triangle_mate_set: Z=N(z)-{x,y} has size 12 and lies outside L, because z has no neighbor in X or Y.

premises.endpoint: n3=4158, equivalently no induced triangular prism

rank_completion.equality_case: If rank(K)=rank(B), every outside restricted column K[L,w] lies in col(B).
rank_completion.restriction_space: R=col([B,C]) is the restriction to L of the full column space
rank_completion.syndrome_identification: Because B is symmetric, col(B)=ker(B)^perp; the eight (or six) kernel dot products identify F_7^L/col(B).

scope: Conditional characteristic-seven equality-regime obstruction at the prism-free endpoint n3=4158
